parameters.query:
WITH reservation AS (
    INSERT INTO driver_reservations (
        driver_id, trip_id, assignment_id
    )
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING driver_id, trip_id, assignment_id
)
SELECT
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reservation) AS reserved,
    (SELECT driver_id FROM reservation) AS driver_id,
    (SELECT trip_id FROM reservation) AS trip_id,
    (SELECT assignment_id FROM reservation) AS assignment_id;

WITH saved AS (
    INSERT INTO action_tokens (
        assignment_id, trip_id, driver_id,
        action, token_hash, expires_at
    )
    VALUES
        ($1, $2, $3, 'PRANO', $4, $6::timestamptz),
        ($1, $2, $3, 'REFUZO', $5, $6::timestamptz)
    ON CONFLICT (token_hash) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING action
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS inserted_count
FROM saved;
